plan.title: Muscle treated vs control limma-trend DE + GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: The core facility delivered log2(TPM+1) normalized values, not raw counts, for 6 treated vs 6 control muscle samples (12000 genes x 12 samples, single batch, unpaired). This rules out count-based models (DESeq2/edgeR/voom): the data is already on a log scale, so the grounded procedure is a limma linear model with the empirical-Bayes trend option (limma-trend), which fits the mean-variance relationship of log-abundance data directly. The plan runs: (1) sample-structure QC (PCA/MDS, sample distances, detected-gene counts) on the log2 values to catch any single-batch structure or outliers before modeling; (2) a mean-log-expression filter to remove low-abundance genes, with the floor set independent of group labels; (3) an explicit check that no further normalization is applied (values are already normalized) plus a value-range sanity check; (4) an explicit factor releveling (control as reference) and named contrast (treated - control) fit with limma (trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE), moderated t-test, BH-adjusted p-values; (5) fgsea preranked GSEA on the limma moderated t-statistic against MSigDB Hallmark (primary) and Reactome (follow-up), both staged in the reference store for human; (6) a reproducibility-recording report with the DE table, thresholds, gene counts, and enrichment results with leading-edge genes. This procedure was checked against the knowledge service and passed with zero violations.
